Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: LuminaHealth evaluation kickoff: propose slots & success criteria

Hi Sara — great to meet today, thanks for the thoughtful conversation about where LuminaHealth wants to apply LLMs for chart-summary generation. Quick recap and a proposed next step: 

Recap (from today):
- Primary goal: reduce clinician note-review time by surfacing structured summaries and suggested follow-ups.
- Success metric: 30% reduction in average chart review time for PCPs in the pilot group; maintain >= 95% factuality on key fields.
- Data scope: de-identified outpatient visit notes for ~2k visits across 3 clinics.
- Security: you need SOC2 evidence + VPC option for the pilot.

Next step: technical deep dive + evaluation kickoff where we align trial plan, success criteria, and the initial prompt/eval set. Proposed 60–75 minute slots (all in PT):
1) Tue Feb 23, 9:30–10:45am PT
2) Wed Feb 24, 2:00–3:15pm PT
3) Thu Feb 25, 11:00–12:15pm PT

Please let me know which slot works and who from your side will attend (PM, data engineer, security lead). We'll bring a solutions engineer and Marissa (she'll lead the trial plan).

I've attached a short trial-plan template and a suggested kickoff agenda to help you prep. If you have an existing prompt set or sample de-id notes, please share ahead of the call (SFTP or SharePoint link).

Open items for the call:
- Confirm pilot scope and sample size
- Agree on success metrics and evaluation cadence
- Determine data access and redaction strategy

Thanks — happy to adjust times.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: redwood-trial-plan-template.xlsx (spreadsheet), eval-kickoff-agenda.pdf (PDF)

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the clear recap. Wed Feb 24, 2:00–3:15pm PT works for our team. Attendees from Lumina: myself (Sara, Head of Product), Daniel Park (Data Engineer), and Elena Martinez (Clinical Safety).

A couple of quick clarifying Qs before we lock in:
- Is 75 minutes the expected length? We may be tight if you need a deep technical demo + trial planning. If possible, can we split to 60 minutes with a follow-up technical-only hour the same week?
- We will prepare a small sample of de-identified notes (no PHI) and a doc with 12 target fields we'd like the summaries to surface. Is that sufficient for the initial prompt/eval pack?

Also — we need the SOC2 docs and a brief on your VPC/private deployment options in advance for our security team to review. Could you share those when you confirm the slot?

Onward — Sara
